title: IV fluid tonicity

findings.where: src/explainer.jsx: start(); images 1 and 8, opening 'Watch the explainer'
findings.title: Opening the explainer drops keyboard focus
findings.problem: Starting the explainer unmounts the focused Watch button without transferring focus. scrollIntoView() only scrolls; it does not focus the player. Keyboard users lose their active control at the transition.
findings.fix: Move focus to the persistent section before removing the Watch button, or focus the Play button after the step controls mount. Use preventScroll to avoid a second scroll.

assessment: No confirmed clinical or diagram-content errors. One keyboard-accessibility defect remains in the shared player.
